route_summary: Prepare DynamoDB API requests for agent session state, optional status index, item expiration, point in time recovery and change streams.
supported_boundary: Offline request planning for a new DynamoDB agent/session table using string keys, on-demand billing and AWS managed KMS, with separately selected status index, TTL, recovery and streams. No AWS execution, response matcher, existing-table migration, IAM provisioning, global tables, customer-managed KMS or immediate TTL deletion.
